name: Driven turbulence
blurb: Isothermal gas in a periodic box, stirred by a random force at the largest scales (Ornstein-Uhlenbeck modes, solenoidal): eddies break up into smaller ones down to the grid, and the flow settles into steady turbulence near Mach 1. The driving follows the taranis WebGPU reduced-MHD page of Mallet & Abraham (alfredmallet.github.io/taranis/webgpu/rmhd2d.html), with the method of Eswaran & Pope (1988) and Federrath et al. (2010).

featured.label: Driving strength
featured.tip: The rms acceleration of the stirring force: the turbulence's speed goes roughly as its square root. Changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Solenoidal share
featured.tip: 1 stirs without compressing, 0 compresses only, 0.5 is the natural mix. Changing it starts the run again
